source: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer (USA, from the USDA CroplandCROS image service), AAFC Annual Crop Inventory (Canada), RPG parcels declared under the CAP (France), 2019-2024
method: random windows (6 km rasters sampled every 4th 30 m pixel; 2 km RPG windows on a 25 × 25 grid of points), cropland-weighted, never in the cells of experiment H; counts of season triples a>b>c (Zixtaro crop ids; "_" = a crop the engine does not rank); a non-cropland year breaks the sequence
